text:
nora: heads-up — FinTechCo (acct: fintechco-prod) reports intermittent 429s between 09:10–09:25 UTC this morning. Customers see bursts of failures; they attached three request ids: req-1a2b3c, req-4d5e6f, req-7g8h9i.

nora: example response they pasted: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` + headers they showed: `x-request-id: req-1a2b3c`, `x-rate-limit-limit: 120`, `x-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `x-rate-limit-reset: 1678905678`, `retry-after: 3`

alex: thanks — can you paste the exact API endpoint + body they used? Also which API key (org token) was in use (prod vs sandbox)? Need plan (Paid/Free) and whether they have a Dedicated contract.

nora: endpoint: `POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
request body: `{"model":"rwd-4-small","prompt":"..."}`
They say this is using their prod key (org: fintechco-prod).

jamie: can you get a HAR or curl repro? Quick curl to reproduce (client-side):
```bash
curl -X POST \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-4-small","prompt":"test rate limit"}' -i
```
If you can reproduce, add `-v` and paste the response headers. Also include the `x-request-id` values from the 429 responses.

support-bot: debug-bundle collector started for fintechco-prod — attach HAR + request ids to ticket #SUP-4821 to auto-link logs.

alex: if HAR not possible, please run this small burst script from a machine in the same region to show short-term QPS spike (only run for repro window):
```bash
seq 1 40 | xargs -n1 -P10 -I{} curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total} %{url_effective}\n" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-xxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-4-small","prompt":"burst test"}'
```
This will give a sense of 200 vs 429 distribution and timings. Tag any failing lines with the `x-request-id` header (add `-i` if you need headers).

jamie: also please set a debug header when reproducing so server adds extra traces: `Redwood-Debug: 1` — that will create a debug id in logs we can search.

nora: got it. I'll ask the customer for the HAR and run the script from their staging host. I'll paste outputs (response headers + any `x-request-id`s) here. ETA ~30m.

eng-oncall: quick note — check whether the customer's token is hitting global burst protections (per-org short-window) vs per-route. If they're on Dedicated, ensure their pool capacity isn't exhausted (we saw similar with small prompt sizes where QPS spiked).

alex: once we have HAR + curl output, we want: 1) request ids 2) full response headers for each 429 3) client timestamped timeline (UTC) 4) whether they used streaming or not. We'll attach all to the support ticket and escalate to rate-limit infra if pattern shows > allowed short-window QPS.

jamie: if you can't reproduce, still grab the customer's API key last 6 chars and the org id so we can cross-check broker logs. Don't share full keys in Slack — redact.

nora: putting this on the ticket and pinging the customer now. I'll add `req-1a2b3c` etc to the debug bundle once they send the HAR. :eyes:

alex: perfect — thanks. I added SUP-4821 to the thread. Will keep monitoring here. :thumbsup:
